limitations: Illustration, not reproduction of the publication validation.
Cyclic mean does not meet the strict constant-mean stationarity assumption.
R is a sensitivity assumption and is not calibrated to injected measurement noise.
Bilinear interpolation follows published code, including root-branch swaps; not a recomputed optimum.
No proof of universal superiority; all model comparisons share the same targets.
exploration: Change noise memory: lag correlations, map point and table weights respond.
Add a cycle and vary the horizon: positive or negative lag correlations are computed from the same series.
Change R only: data and correlations remain fixed; colours and coefficients may change, error can remain nearly constant.
Move the explained target: numerical contributions change; whole-test scores remain fixed.
Switch map field only: forecast and all scores remain fixed.
Toggle zoom: only chart ranges change; the explained target and all whole-test scores stay fixed.
Inspect a map cell with pointer, touch or arrow keys: the inspection crosshair and readout change; the estimated-series circle and forecast stay fixed.

verification.scope: targeted prototype verification, not universal method validation
verification.numericalScope: 432 cases exercise numerical calculations, a lookup/prediction fixture and forecast-origin causality; they do not automate DOM, zoom, map pointer/keyboard or help-popup behavior.

interfaceEvidence.scope: separate recorded interface evidence, not assertions executed by check-intuition.cjs
